purpose: Fresh held-out pool for a future confirmatory evaluation. Do not evaluate, inspect predictions on, or tune against these queries until the final protocol is frozen.
excluded: pilot dev/val/test queries, all review-sheet queries, and exact/near-duplicates (normalized text or token Jaccard >= 0.8) of pilot queries
caveat: Same five source subsets and tool families as the pilot: this is NOT an unseen-family split.
